intro.en: Automotive primary wire is the single-core electrical path inside a vehicle harness. It feeds lighting, actuators, relays, sensors and control units, but the correct construction depends on the circuit, installation zone and governing cable specification rather than colour or gauge alone.
intro.zh: 汽车电线是整车线束内部的单芯电气路径，用于照明、执行器、继电器、传感器和控制单元等回路。正确结构由回路、安装温区和适用线缆规范共同决定，不能只看颜色或线径。

knowledge.en: A conductor marked with the same nominal size can differ in strand construction, finished resistance, insulation wall, outside diameter, temperature class and fluid resistance. Those differences affect voltage drop, terminal compatibility, bundle diameter, routing and long-term reliability.
knowledge.zh: 即使标称截面积相同，导体绞合、成品电阻、绝缘壁厚、外径、温度等级和耐介质性能仍可能不同。这些差异会影响压降、端子兼容、线束直径、布线空间与长期可靠性。

notes.en: Identify the circuit current and duty, nominal system voltage, route length, ambient and self-heating, terminal wire range, fluid and abrasion exposure, cable standard, colour code and marking before source approval.
notes.zh: 物料批准前应明确回路电流与占空比、系统电压、路径长度、环境温度与自发热、端子适用线径、油液和磨损暴露、线缆标准、颜色代码及印字。

delivery.en: Release records the exact cable designation and source, conductor size and resistance criteria, insulation construction, colour and marking, cut and strip dimensions, terminal pairing and the electrical, dimensional and workmanship checks agreed for the harness.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录准确线缆型号与来源、导体截面积和电阻判定、绝缘结构、颜色与印字、裁线剥线尺寸、端子配对，以及线束约定的电气、尺寸和工艺检查。

subtitle.en: Select the electrical path by circuit, zone and terminal system
subtitle.zh: 按回路、温区与端子系统选择电气路径

lead.en: Start with current and route length, then coordinate conductor, insulation, terminal and installed environment.
lead.zh: 先确认电流与路径长度，再协同选择导体、绝缘、端子和安装环境。

title.en: SAE J1128 and ISO 19642 are specification families, not interchangeable labels
title.zh: SAE J1128 与 ISO 19642 是规范体系，不是可互换标签

copy.en: SAE J1128 covers low-voltage primary cable for surface-vehicle systems within its stated voltage scope, while the ISO 19642 series separates automotive cable vocabulary, tests and construction requirements across multiple parts. GPT, GXL, SXL, TXL and ISO thin-wall designations describe defined constructions. A drawing should state the exact requested standard, type, revision or customer specification instead of combining familiar names into an unsupported description.
copy.zh: SAE J1128 在其规定电压范围内覆盖地面车辆低压一次电缆；ISO 19642 系列则把汽车线缆术语、试验与不同结构要求分列在多个部分。GPT、GXL、SXL、TXL 以及 ISO 薄壁线名称分别对应明确结构。图纸应写明所需标准、类型、版本或客户规范，不能把熟悉的名称随意组合成未经依据的描述。

title.en: Conductor area must be checked against current, length and allowable voltage drop
title.zh: 导体截面积要同时核对电流、长度与允许压降

copy.en: Nominal gauge is only the starting point. Circuit duty, bundle derating, ambient temperature, connector contact resistance and the round-trip path influence conductor temperature and load voltage. Fine stranding can improve handling, but strand count alone does not prove ampacity or flex life. Engineering should calculate the actual circuit and confirm finished-conductor resistance against the applicable specification.
copy.zh: 标称线径只是起点。回路占空比、成束降额、环境温度、连接器接触电阻和往返路径都会影响导体温升与负载端电压。细绞结构可以改善装配手感，但股数本身不能证明载流量或弯折寿命。工程审核应计算实际回路，并依据适用规范确认成品导体电阻。

title.en: Thin-wall insulation saves package space only when the whole system remains compatible
title.zh: 薄壁绝缘只有在整套系统兼容时才真正节省空间

copy.en: A smaller outside diameter can reduce bundle mass and improve routing through clips, grommets and connector backshells. It also changes stripping behaviour, terminal insulation support and abrasion margin. The wire, applicator, terminal, seal and cavity must therefore be reviewed as one crimp system. Substituting a thin-wall cable by nominal conductor size alone can create loose seals or incorrect support geometry.
copy.zh: 更小外径可以降低线束体积与重量，也更容易穿过卡扣、护套和连接器尾部，但同时会改变剥线表现、端子绝缘支撑和耐磨余量。因此线材、压接模具、端子、密封圈与孔位必须作为一套压接系统审核。仅按标称截面积替换薄壁线，可能造成密封松动或支撑几何错误。

title.en: Temperature class belongs to the installed zone, not the vehicle as a whole
title.zh: 温度等级属于具体安装区域，不属于整车笼统标签

copy.en: A cabin branch, door harness, engine-bay circuit and path near an exhaust shield can experience very different continuous temperatures, peaks and thermal cycling. Conductor self-heating adds to the local environment. Select insulation from a defined temperature profile and required life, then keep the harness away from hot surfaces or add suitable protection where routing cannot avoid them.
copy.zh: 座舱支路、车门线束、发动机舱回路以及靠近排气隔热板的路径，持续温度、峰值温度与冷热循环完全不同，导体自发热还会叠加在局部环境上。应依据明确温度谱和寿命要求选择绝缘；布线应远离热表面，确实无法避开时再配置合适防护。

title.en: Oil, coolant, washer fluid and abrasion create different material risks
title.zh: 油液、冷却液、玻璃水与磨损带来不同材料风险

copy.en: Fluid exposure is defined by chemical, concentration, temperature, contact time and repetition. Abrasion depends on contact pressure, relative movement, edge geometry and contamination. A generic claim such as oil resistant cannot replace the project exposure list. Route control, clips, convoluted tube, braid or local sleeves may be required in addition to the base wire insulation.
copy.zh: 介质暴露要由化学品种类、浓度、温度、接触时间和重复次数定义；磨损则取决于接触压力、相对运动、边缘形状与污染物。笼统的“耐油”不能替代项目介质清单。除基础绝缘外，还可能需要路径控制、卡扣、波纹管、编织套或局部护套。

title.en: Colour and marking are circuit controls, not decoration
title.zh: 颜色与印字是回路控制，不是装饰

copy.en: Base colour, stripe or tracer, printed circuit identification and cut-label information must match the drawing and service logic. Colour systems vary between manufacturers and customer specifications, so a colour name alone should never be treated as a universal circuit function. Approved samples, colour references and legible marking rules reduce assembly and maintenance errors.
copy.zh: 底色、条纹或示踪色、线身回路印字以及裁线标签都应与图纸和维修逻辑一致。不同制造商与客户规范的颜色体系并不相同，因此某个颜色名称不能被视为全球通用回路功能。确认色样、颜色参考和可读印字规则，有助于减少装配与维修错误。

title.en: The terminal sets the acceptable wire range and crimp geometry
title.zh: 端子决定可接受线径范围与压接几何

copy.en: Conductor barrel, insulation support, seal range and applicator tooling must match the actual cable dimensions. Strip length, bellmouth, brush, conductor compression and insulation support are controlled features; pull force alone cannot describe every crimp condition. When a wire source changes, outside diameter, strand construction and insulation hardness should be reviewed before production release.
copy.zh: 导体压接翼、绝缘支撑、密封圈范围和压接模具必须匹配线缆实际尺寸。剥线长度、喇叭口、刷尾、导体压缩和绝缘支撑都是受控特征；单一拉力结果不能描述全部压接状态。更换线材来源时，应在量产放行前重新核对外径、绞合结构和绝缘硬度。

title.en: Validate the finished harness in its real electrical and mechanical context
title.zh: 要在真实电气与机械条件下验证成品线束

copy.en: Incoming wire checks, conductor resistance, dimensions, marking and traceability establish material control. Cut-and-strip inspection, crimp cross-section or other agreed workmanship evidence controls termination. The completed harness then requires continuity and project-defined checks for voltage drop, insulation, sealing, temperature, vibration or environmental exposure. A cable standard does not replace validation of the assembled system.
copy.zh: 来料线缆检查、导体电阻、尺寸、印字和追溯建立物料控制；裁线剥线检查、压接截面或其他约定工艺证据控制端接质量。完整线束还需执行导通，以及项目规定的压降、绝缘、密封、温度、振动或环境检查。线缆标准不能替代对装配后系统的验证。

inputs.en: Applicable cable standard, exact type and customer specification
inputs.zh: 适用线缆标准、准确类型与客户规范

inputs.en: System voltage, circuit current, duty and route length
inputs.zh: 系统电压、回路电流、占空比与路径长度

inputs.en: Installation zones, temperatures, fluids and abrasion points
inputs.zh: 安装区域、温度、介质与磨损位置

inputs.en: Conductor size, colour, stripe, printing and traceability
inputs.zh: 导体规格、颜色、条纹、印字与追溯要求

inputs.en: Terminal, seal, connector cavity and crimp tooling references
inputs.zh: 端子、密封圈、连接器孔位与压接模具资料

inputs.en: Harness drawing, quantity, sample and acceptance plan
inputs.zh: 线束图纸、数量、样品与验收计划

q.en: Are GPT, GXL, SXL and TXL interchangeable?
q.zh: GPT、GXL、SXL 和 TXL 可以互换吗？

a.en: Not automatically. They differ in construction and performance scope; the drawing, environment, terminal system and governing specification must be reviewed.
a.zh: 不能自动互换。它们的结构与性能范围不同，必须结合图纸、环境、端子系统和适用规范审核。

q.en: Can AWG and mm² be converted directly?
q.zh: AWG 与 mm² 可以直接换算吗？

a.en: A numerical comparison is possible, but the designation systems, conductor requirements and finished resistance criteria are not identical. Use the size required by the applicable specification.
a.zh: 数值可以进行近似比较，但两种标称体系、导体要求与成品电阻判定并不完全相同，应采用适用规范规定的尺寸。

q.en: Does thicker insulation always mean better automotive wire?
q.zh: 绝缘越厚，汽车线就一定越好吗？

a.en: No. Wall thickness, material, temperature class, abrasion, terminal support, bundle space and mass must be balanced for the installation.
a.zh: 不是。壁厚、材料、温度等级、耐磨、端子支撑、线束空间和重量要针对安装条件综合平衡。

q.en: Can cable colour prove circuit function?
q.zh: 可以通过线色直接判断回路功能吗？

a.en: No universal colour-to-function mapping applies to every vehicle or customer. Use the approved drawing and circuit identification rules.
a.zh: 不存在适用于所有车辆与客户的通用颜色功能映射，必须以确认图纸和回路标识规则为准。

q.en: Is an automotive cable standard enough to approve a harness?
q.zh: 符合汽车线缆标准就足以放行线束吗？

a.en: No. The terminal, seal, splice, routing, protection and completed harness still require project-specific workmanship and functional validation.
a.zh: 不足。端子、密封圈、接点、布线、防护和完整线束仍需执行项目规定的工艺与功能验证。

q.en: What should be sent for a wire-source substitution review?
q.zh: 审核线材替代时应提供什么？

a.en: Send both specifications, conductor and insulation dimensions, resistance, temperature and fluid properties, colour and marking, terminal compatibility, source traceability and the required revalidation plan.
a.zh: 请提供新旧规格、导体与绝缘尺寸、电阻、温度和耐介质性能、颜色印字、端子兼容、来源追溯及所需再验证计划。
